mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_memo_snapshot (memo_id, yjs_state, content_hash, commit_message, saved_at) VALUES (#{memoId}, #{yjsState}, #{contentHash}, #{commitMessage}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workspace_memo_snapshot WHERE memo_id = #{memoId} ORDER BY saved_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM workspace_memo_snapshot WHERE memo_id = #{memoId} AND commit_message IS NOT NULL AND commit_message <> '' ORDER BY saved_at DESC LIMIT 1
